name: dsh-scorpio
description: dsh-scorpio（天蝎座 Scorpio）: a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that ships a real-time online TRPG agent preset. Its capability is split into three axes — 【世界书】(a worldbook in the workspace, each able to hold several rulebooks of different flavours: d100 / d20 / d6 pool) · 【模组集】(per-world modules, each an opening hook for one adventure) · 【角色卡】(a per-world character pool, one of which is imported into a session) — plus a dice adjudication engine (NdM±K, named checks, opposed rolls) that every important action must pass through. Each session is a tuple of world + rulebook + module + character; the configuration window registers through ctx.betterSidebar while the dice card is a draggable overlay registered on shell.overlay.

scripts.selftest: node src/host/selftest.ts && node src/host/presettest.ts && node src/host/presetprobe.ts
